data.description:
Name: Non Toyoguchi
Kanji: 豊口 のん
Romaji: Toyoguchi Non
Alias: Clumsy Girl, Dark Horse, Rubber Woman
Birthday: September 2
Age: 19
Gender: Female
Height: 169 cm

Appearance
Non has an hourglass figure, long light crimson hair, tied up into pigtails, raspberry colored eyes, and fair skin.

In anime, Rin deduces that Non is either a G or an H-Cup.

Personality
Non is a sweet, bubbly, cheerful person. She is always smiling. However, Non is also completely clumsy, frequently tripped over any stuff around her and causing trouble for her friends.

Main Ability: Soft Butt
Fighting Style: Counter
Counters are fighters that focused on defense and utilized their opponent's strength to convert it into their own attack. The Counters usually tend to reflect their opponent's movement before striking them down if they manage to find an opening. Due to their lack of speed, they are disadvantaged if they face off against the Outfighters. However, they have the advantage if they face off against the Infighters.

Non's fighting style is classified as a Counter. Although it is frequently shown that she is just lucky by accidentally defeating her opponent, Non is skilled enough when participating in team matches. She is also able to use her chest and butt to support her teammates.

Incredible Soft Buns: Killer Butt (尻殺しの軟尻体質, Shiri-goroshi no Nanketsu Taishitsu): Non's main ability. Her butt is incredibly soft, capable of bouncing her opponent away.

Suction Exploding Butt Wave (吸引爆尻波, Kyūin Bakuketsu-ha): By using her "Soft Butt", Non is always able to bounce her opponent away in an instant. However, she, in fact, is also able to hold from countering direct attacks for a certain period of time. While holding from blasting them away, Non's butt shape looks abstract as a result of being assaulted. By the time she decides to release all the attacks she had absorbed earlier, Non releases a massive amount of air pressure that blasts the opponent away. This technique allows Non to counter Misaki Rindou, one of the Five Butts.
Bonn B Way (ボン・バ・ウェイ, Bon Bi Uei): Converting a considerably large amount of spring energy from her butt, Non catapults herself. The technique was first used by Non on the 5th race of the second preliminary round of Ikumi Yuzuki's Butt Graduation Festival in order to dodge Misaki Rindou.
Shadow Butt Afterglow (残光宝影尻, Zankō Hōiketsu): Non's "Soft Butt" is able to absorb direct attacks from the opponent and hold from releasing the attacks she had absorbed for extended periods of time. By the time Non decides to unleash all of them, the opponent will see after images of themselves. Thus, the opponent receives their own attacks.
1.6 Kilo Breast Napalm (1.6キロ乳ナパーム, 1.6-Kiro Chichi Napāmu): Non jumps over her opponent, before dropping her bust down on to them.

1.6 Kilo Breast Cannon (1.6キロ乳キャノン, 1.6-Kiro Chichi Kyanon): By utilizing the weight of her breasts, Non pushes her boobs toward her opponent's face. It is strong enough to knock them down.

Warp the Shot (ワープ・ザ・ショット, Wāpu za Shotto): By taking direct attacks from the opponent, Non transforms the attacks into her own strength, channeling them into her boobs. She then assaults the opponent in the face
